# Tailwind CSS patterns

Use when styling components, configuring theme tokens, or reviewing Tailwind class usage.

## Class composition rules
- Always use complete static class names (`isError ? "text-red-600" : "text-slate-700"`). Never assemble classes dynamically (`text-${color}-600`), because Tailwind's content scanner drops unresolvable strings in production builds.
- Configure design tokens once in `@theme` (v4) or `tailwind.config` (`theme.extend`) instead of repeating arbitrary hex values like `bg-[#1f2937]` across files.
- Prefer `class-variance-authority` (or typed variant maps) + `tailwind-merge` when reusable primitives accept caller `className` overrides.

## Layout and maintenance
- Extract repeated multi-element patterns into framework components (React/Svelte/Astro components) rather than hiding large class lists behind `@apply`.
- Use Tailwind's logical spacing/gap utilities (`flex gap-4`, `grid`) and responsive prefixes (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`) mobile-first without overriding base specificity.

## Accessibility and states
- Include clear `focus-visible:outline` styles, `disabled:` affordances, and sufficient color contrast across both light and dark tokens (`dark:`).
- Use `motion-reduce:` utilities for animations and `sr-only` for accessible icon-only control labels.

## Verify
Inspect production CSS build output for unexpected purges, check keyboard focus rings across interactive elements, and test narrow mobile plus desktop viewports.
